estimates.name: Option B- Indoor air quality  - Copy
estimates.summary:
-Installing a pristine air ultraviolet light system. It will eliminate microbial growth as well as airborne bacteria and viruses. It will sanitize the air in the home. 
-The PremierOne MUV-403H is a high-intensity, duct-mounted UVC germicidal air purifier with an adjustable oxidation chamber. It uses a dual-lamp system to neutralize bacteria, mold, viruses, and VOCs, auto-sensing ballast, 2-year lamp life, and a 16-inch high-output lamp.

estimates.name: Total Service Repair - Copy
estimates.summary:
The permanent repairs for the Winters Estate property will begin with excavation to expose the existing PPL underground feeder conductors. Once exposed, the existing underground conduit will be cut back farther from the stone wall where the current meter is mounted. A new section of conduit will then be installed and extended to a new meter socket, which will be mounted on the face of the stone block wall in a location that provides a safe, code-compliant installation.

A new exterior main service disconnect will be installed adjacent to the new meter socket to meet current electrical code requirements. Two new grounding electrodes (ground rods) will be driven and connected to the new service disconnect to establish a proper grounding electrode system. The existing water and gas piping do not require bonding and will remain as is.

Because the relocation of the meter and service disconnect increases the distance to the electrical equipment inside the home, the existing service entrance conductors will no longer be long enough to be reused. Three new 250 kcmil copper service conductors and one new #2 copper equipment grounding conductor will be installed from the exterior disconnect into the basement.

Inside the home, a new service trough will be installed to provide a proper transition point for the service conductors before feeding two new 200-amp subpanels. The existing basement electrical panels and associated branch circuits will be consolidated into these two new panels, providing a clean, organized, and code-compliant electrical distribution system that will safely supply power to the entire residence.

This complete service replacement is necessary due to the extensive corrosion and deterioration within the existing meter base and service equipment. The new installation will provide a safe, reliable, and code-compliant electrical service for the home while eliminating the issues that have prevented the existing equipment from operating properly.
